announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director dealings follow recent scrip dividend admissions. Shareholders should monitor for further insider activity.

announcements.headline: Issue of Scrip Dividend Shares & Admission to AIM
announcements.insight: GWI admits to AIM following scrip dividend share issuance. This follows the September half-year report and earlier credit rating maintenance.

announcements.headline: Half-year Report
announcements.insight: Half-year report published. Fitch rating maintained in June; scrip dividend price set in September.

announcements.headline: Scrip Dividend Share Reference Price
announcements.insight: Globalworth Real Estate Investments Limited announces a scrip dividend share reference price. This follows its recent maintenance of an investment grade credit rating by Fitch.

announcements.headline: Fitch investment grade credit rating maintained
announcements.insight: Globalworth Real Estate Investments Limited maintains its investment grade credit rating. This stability supports financial credibility for future capital allocation.
